subject: life-skills
description: Life Skills skill tree. Grades 1–3 are CAPS Foundation Phase (Beginning Knowledge & Health Education strand). Grades 4–6 are CAPS Intermediate Phase, covering the Personal & Social Well-being study area only — Creative Arts and Physical Education are activity-based and don't fit a question-bank tutor, so they're out of scope.

levels.title: Grade 1 — Life Skills
levels.description: CAPS Foundation Phase Grade 1. 12 topics across the year, 2 hours/week Beginning Knowledge & Health Education. Topics do not prerequisite each other — all unlocked from day one.

atomic_skills.title: Me and my body
atomic_skills.description: Personal details, body parts, hygiene, common communicable diseases.

atomic_skills.title: My school
atomic_skills.description: Classroom layout, routines, rules, school structure, evacuation signals, safety.

atomic_skills.title: My family
atomic_skills.description: Family members, roles, family tree, safe/unsafe situations at home, emergency contacts.

atomic_skills.title: Ways of travelling
atomic_skills.description: Modes of transport, common road signs, crossing safely, rules in moving vehicles.

atomic_skills.title: Food and nutrition
atomic_skills.description: Food preferences, plant growth, food groups, water intake, nutritious choices, traditional foods.

atomic_skills.title: Domestic animals
atomic_skills.description: Pets vs farm animals, care for animals, products from animals (dairy etc).

atomic_skills.title: Stories of heroes
atomic_skills.description: Important people in SA history, qualities of a hero, basic rescue skills.

atomic_skills.title: People who help us
atomic_skills.description: Community helpers and their roles, emergency numbers.

atomic_skills.title: Familiar places (my village / town / city / neighbourhood)
atomic_skills.description: Places close to home and school, important buildings, parks, sporting facilities.

atomic_skills.title: Family life: now and then
atomic_skills.description: Older family members' experiences, objects from the past, lifestyle then vs now.

atomic_skills.title: Being a good friend
atomic_skills.description: Qualities of a good friend, bullying, recognising and reporting abuse (verbal/physical/sexual). SENSITIVE — scenario-based authoring, not standard recall.
atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: AUTHOR: per-topic remediation hint. NOTE: handle abuse-reporting content with extreme care; recovery should reinforce that telling a trusted adult is always the right thing.

atomic_skills.title: Stories of different South African communities
atomic_skills.description: Stories from diverse SA communities, similarities and differences, customs, festivals, healthy foods.

levels.title: Grade 2 — Life Skills
levels.description: CAPS Foundation Phase Grade 2. 12 topics across the year, 2 hours/week Beginning Knowledge & Health Education.

atomic_skills.title: Homes in different places
atomic_skills.description: Types of homes, homes for different weather, mobile homes, safety at home.

atomic_skills.title: Water
atomic_skills.description: Sources, purification, water cycle, aquatic life, water safety, effects of dirty water.

atomic_skills.title: Weather and seasons
atomic_skills.description: Weather observation, seasonal changes, suitable clothing, effects on plants/animals/fruit.

atomic_skills.title: How my body works
atomic_skills.description: External and internal organs and their functions, skeleton, body care, healthy lifestyle.

atomic_skills.title: Foods eaten by different communities
atomic_skills.description: Dietary choices across communities, world foods, cooking methods, recipes, food allergies.

atomic_skills.title: Energy resources
atomic_skills.description: Types of energy (electricity, petrol, paraffin, solar, wind, wood), home/school usage, hazards, first aid.

atomic_skills.title: Wild animals
atomic_skills.description: Common SA wild animals, classifications (herbivore/carnivore/omnivore), animal diseases.

atomic_skills.title: Relationships and handling emotions
atomic_skills.description: Different relationships, emotions in different situations, handling emotions, classroom behaviour, exercise to manage feelings. SENSITIVE — scenario-based authoring.
atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: AUTHOR: per-topic remediation hint. NOTE: emotional regulation content — recovery should normalise feelings, not correct them.

atomic_skills.title: Keeping our environment clean
atomic_skills.description: Healthy home/school/local environment, hygiene-related diseases (diarrhoea, TB).

atomic_skills.title: National symbols and the national anthem
atomic_skills.description: SA national symbols, currency, sports teams, holidays, flag, anthem, communicable diseases.

atomic_skills.title: People at work
atomic_skills.description: Types of work, careers, protective clothing for different jobs.

atomic_skills.title: The planets and the stars
atomic_skills.description: Solar system, planet names, sun and its uses, moon phases, space travel, sun protection.

levels.title: Grade 3 — Life Skills
levels.description: CAPS Foundation Phase Grade 3. 12 topics across the year, 3 hours/week Beginning Knowledge & Health Education (50% more than Gr 1/2). Item density target 15–20 per topic.

atomic_skills.title: Clothes and the materials they are made from
atomic_skills.description: Clothing categories, materials, processing, cultural and seasonal clothing, protective wear, clothing care.

atomic_skills.title: Farming the land
atomic_skills.description: Farm-grown foods, home garden, food production processes, staple foods, healthy eating.

atomic_skills.title: Extinct and endangered creatures
atomic_skills.description: Dinosaur age, kinds of dinosaurs, how species become extinct, endangered animals, safety with sharp objects.

atomic_skills.title: Communication then and now
atomic_skills.description: Communication history, radio/telegraph/TV/newspapers, modern communication (SMS, email, internet), safety with media.

atomic_skills.title: Communicable diseases
atomic_skills.description: Communicable diseases (HIV/AIDS, flu, cholera, measles, TB), causes, prevention, symptoms, treatment, caring for sick family, coping with grief and loss. SENSITIVE — handle with care.
atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: AUTHOR: per-topic remediation hint. NOTE: grief and HIV/AIDS content — recovery must be supportive, not corrective; reinforce empathy and trusted-adult resources.

atomic_skills.title: Famous places in South Africa
atomic_skills.description: Local famous places, SA heritage sites, locating places on a map, safety in public.

atomic_skills.title: Stories from key South African historical events
atomic_skills.description: Family history, simple time line, events affecting SA communities, phrases for passing time (before/after/long ago).

atomic_skills.title: Pollution and recycling
atomic_skills.description: Types of pollution (water/air/land), effects on humans and environment, recycling, recyclable waste, illnesses from pollution.

atomic_skills.title: Natural disasters
atomic_skills.description: Severe weather experiences, natural disasters and their results, climatic changes (global warming), water-borne diseases.

atomic_skills.title: Stories of role models from different cultures
atomic_skills.description: Family/community role models, characteristics of a good role model, diversity of role models, contributions to medicine/sports/literature.

atomic_skills.title: Understanding myself: my abilities, interests, rights and responsibilities
atomic_skills.description: Own abilities and interests, classmates' abilities, rights and responsibilities, classroom rules, health/safety responsibilities. SENSITIVE — self-esteem content.
atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: AUTHOR: per-topic remediation hint. NOTE: self-esteem content — recovery should affirm the learner's worth, not just correct knowledge gaps.

atomic_skills.title: Celebrations and festivals
atomic_skills.description: Religious and cultural celebrations, personal celebration experiences, traditional clothes, religious symbols and worship, places of worship, home safety measures.

levels.title: Grade 4 — Life Skills
levels.description: CAPS Intermediate Phase Grade 4, Personal & Social Well-being study area. 1½ hours/week, 60 hours/year, 15 topics across Development of the Self, Health & Environmental Responsibility, and Social Responsibility. Topics are flat — no prerequisites between them — but the CAPS doc fixes which term each must be covered in.

atomic_skills.title: Personal strengths
atomic_skills.description: Identifying own strengths, learning from successful and less successful experiences, using strengths to improve weaknesses.

atomic_skills.title: Respect for own and others' bodies
atomic_skills.description: Privacy and bodily integrity, caring for own body, respecting others' bodies, not subjecting one's body to substance abuse.

atomic_skills.title: Dealing with conflict
atomic_skills.description: Examples of conflict at home and school, strategies to avoid conflict, useful responses to conflict situations.

atomic_skills.title: Emotions: understanding a range of emotions
atomic_skills.description: Love, happiness, grief, fear and jealousy. Understanding own emotions and appropriate ways to express them, considering others' emotions.

atomic_skills.title: Working in a group
atomic_skills.description: Working in a class, family or group project. Benefits and challenges of group work, useful responses to challenges.

atomic_skills.title: Bullying: appropriate responses
atomic_skills.description: Recognising acts of bullying, appropriate responses, where to find help. SENSITIVE — scenario-based authoring.
atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: AUTHOR: per-topic remediation hint. NOTE: bullying content — recovery must reinforce that telling a trusted adult is always the right thing.

atomic_skills.title: Children's rights and responsibilities
atomic_skills.description: Rights to name, health, safety, education, shelter, food and a safe environment as stipulated in the SA Constitution; matching responsibilities.

atomic_skills.title: Cultures and moral lessons
atomic_skills.description: Cultural groups in SA, menus from different cultures, moral lessons drawn from the narratives of cultural groups.

atomic_skills.title: Major religions in South Africa
atomic_skills.description: Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, Baha'i Faith and African Religion. Significant places, buildings and worship symbols.

atomic_skills.title: Dangers in and around water
atomic_skills.description: Home and public swimming pools, rivers and dams; responsible safety measures in and around water.

atomic_skills.title: Traffic rules for road users
atomic_skills.description: Pedestrians and cyclists, passenger behaviour, railway safety.

atomic_skills.title: Personal and household hygiene
atomic_skills.description: Personal hygiene items that cannot be shared, germ breeding areas in the house.

atomic_skills.title: Dietary habits of children
atomic_skills.description: Impact of dietary habits on dental and oral hygiene.

atomic_skills.title: Healthy environment and personal health
atomic_skills.description: Home, school and community. Unhealthy environments (air, water, land pollution, illegal dumping), dangers to personal health, conservation strategies, Arbor Day.

atomic_skills.title: HIV and AIDS: basic facts
atomic_skills.description: Basic explanation of HIV and AIDS, transmission through blood, how HIV is not transmitted, protecting oneself against infection through blood. SENSITIVE — handle with care.
atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: AUTHOR: per-topic remediation hint. NOTE: HIV/AIDS content — recovery must be factual and stigma-free; reinforce trusted-adult and clinic resources.

levels.title: Grade 5 — Life Skills
levels.description: CAPS Intermediate Phase Grade 5, Personal & Social Well-being. 1½ hours/week, 60 hours/year, 15 topics. Builds on Gr 4 — emotions deepen into coping skills, rights deepen into discrimination and abuse, hygiene deepens into local health problems and substance abuse.

atomic_skills.title: Positive self-concept formation
atomic_skills.description: Influence of adults and peers on self-concept, personal successes as contributors to a positive self-concept, action plan for continued positive self-concept formation.

atomic_skills.title: Giving and receiving feedback
atomic_skills.description: Appropriate ways of giving positive and negative feedback to peers; appropriate ways of receiving feedback from peers and adults.

atomic_skills.title: Coping with emotions
atomic_skills.description: Empathy, compassion, anger, disappointment and sadness. Skills to manage emotions positively; the significance of friends in times of sadness, tragedy and change.

atomic_skills.title: Relationships with peers, older people and strangers
atomic_skills.description: Safe and unsafe relationships, bad and good relationships, benefits of good and safe relationships.

atomic_skills.title: Discrimination, stereotype and bias
atomic_skills.description: Concepts of discrimination, stereotype and bias as violations of children's rights; how to protect self and others, where to find help, planning a response in own local context.

atomic_skills.title: Child abuse
atomic_skills.description: Forms of child abuse (physical and emotional), effects on personal health, strategies to deal with abuse, where to get help and report abuse. SENSITIVE — handle with extreme care.
atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: AUTHOR: per-topic remediation hint. NOTE: child abuse content — recovery must affirm that abuse is never the child's fault and reinforce trusted-adult and reporting resources (Childline 116).

atomic_skills.title: Dealing with violent situations
atomic_skills.description: Identifying potential violent situations at home, school and community; responding effectively; ways to avoid and protect oneself, where to find help. SENSITIVE — scenario-based authoring.
atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: AUTHOR: per-topic remediation hint. NOTE: violence content — recovery should prioritise getting away safely and telling a trusted adult over confronting.

atomic_skills.title: Issues of age and gender in cultural contexts
atomic_skills.description: Relationships between elders and children in different SA cultural contexts; responsibilities of boys and girls; contributions of women and men.

atomic_skills.title: Festivals and customs of religions in South Africa
atomic_skills.description: Festivals and customs from a variety of religions in South Africa.

atomic_skills.title: Safety measures at home and the environment
atomic_skills.description: Harmful household products and medication, fire safety.

atomic_skills.title: Water as an important basic need
atomic_skills.description: Importance of water, different ways of saving water, protecting the quality of water.

atomic_skills.title: Healthy eating for children
atomic_skills.description: South African Food-Based Dietary Guidelines, dietary needs of children, factors influencing food intake.

atomic_skills.title: Local environmental health problems
atomic_skills.description: Locally occurring health problems (tuberculosis, diarrhoea, malaria, measles etc.) — causes, symptoms, available treatment.

atomic_skills.title: HIV and AIDS: dealing with stigma
atomic_skills.description: Stigma about HIV and AIDS; how to change attitudes towards people infected with HIV and AIDS. SENSITIVE.
atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: AUTHOR: per-topic remediation hint. NOTE: HIV stigma content — recovery should model empathy and challenge myths without shaming the learner for holding them.

atomic_skills.title: Substance abuse
atomic_skills.description: Types of legal and illegal drugs including tobacco, alcohol and over-the-counter medication; negative impact of substances on body and mind. SENSITIVE.
atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: AUTHOR: per-topic remediation hint. NOTE: substance abuse content — recovery should be factual about harm without moralising; reinforce trusted-adult resources.

levels.title: Grade 6 — Life Skills
levels.description: CAPS Intermediate Phase Grade 6, Personal & Social Well-being. 1½ hours/week, 60 hours/year, 16 topics. Final IP year — bridges into Life Orientation in the Senior Phase. Mastery bar lifts to 6 correct.

atomic_skills.title: Positive self-esteem: body image
atomic_skills.description: Understanding and respecting body changes; influences on body image from media and society; acceptance of the self. SENSITIVE — body image content.
atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: AUTHOR: per-topic remediation hint. NOTE: body image content — recovery must affirm body diversity and challenge media ideals without prescribing how a body should look.

atomic_skills.title: Abilities, interests and potential
atomic_skills.description: Identifying own abilities, interests and potential; relationships between them; creating opportunities and action plans to develop them.

atomic_skills.title: Peer pressure
atomic_skills.description: Examples of peer pressure at school and in the community; appropriate responses in different situations.

atomic_skills.title: Problem solving in conflict situations
atomic_skills.description: Keeping safe and protecting self and others; mediation skills; peacekeeping skills (acceptance, respect, co-operation, personal responsibility, listening).

atomic_skills.title: Self management skills
atomic_skills.description: Responsibilities at school and home, prioritising responsibilities, developing an activity plan for homework, chores and play.

atomic_skills.title: Bullying: getting out of the bullying habit
atomic_skills.description: Reasons people bully; getting out of the bullying habit; where to find help. SENSITIVE — angle is the bully not the target this year.
atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: AUTHOR: per-topic remediation hint. NOTE: framed for learners who may themselves be bullying — recovery should be non-shaming and offer concrete alternatives and adult help.

atomic_skills.title: Cultural rites of passage
atomic_skills.description: Important life stages in SA cultures — birth, baptism, wedding, death — and their personal and social significance.

atomic_skills.title: Dignity of the person in religions of SA
atomic_skills.description: How a variety of religions in South Africa frame the dignity of the person.

atomic_skills.title: Caring for animals
atomic_skills.description: Acts of cruelty to animals, taking care of and protecting animals, places of safety for animals (SPCA etc.).

atomic_skills.title: Caring for people
atomic_skills.description: Considering others' needs and views; communicating own views and needs without hurting others; acts of kindness.

atomic_skills.title: Nation-building and cultural heritage
atomic_skills.description: How cultural heritage unifies the nation; national symbols (flag, anthem, coat of arms); national days (Human Rights, Freedom, Heritage, Reconciliation, Children's, Women's, Africa, Mandela Day).

atomic_skills.title: Gender stereotyping, sexism and abuse
atomic_skills.description: Definitions; effects of gender stereotyping and sexism on personal and social relationships; effects of gender-based abuse; dealing with stereotyping, sexism and abuse. SENSITIVE.
atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: AUTHOR: per-topic remediation hint. NOTE: gender abuse content — recovery must validate the harm of stereotypes without lecturing; reinforce reporting and trusted-adult resources.

atomic_skills.title: Basic first aid
atomic_skills.description: Basic first aid for cuts and grazes, burns, scalds and sunburn, stings and bites, bruises, poisoning, bleeding, choking.

atomic_skills.title: Food hygiene
atomic_skills.description: Safe and harmful ingredients, food preparation, food storage, food-borne diseases.

atomic_skills.title: Communicable diseases
atomic_skills.description: Diseases such as mumps, tuberculosis, common colds, chickenpox, athlete's foot; causes, signs and symptoms, prevention strategies, available treatment.

atomic_skills.title: HIV and AIDS: myths and realities
atomic_skills.description: Myths and realities about HIV and AIDS including risks and perceptions; caring for people with AIDS. SENSITIVE.
atomic_skills.recovery_strategy: AUTHOR: per-topic remediation hint. NOTE: HIV myths content — recovery should correct misconceptions factually and reinforce empathy; avoid moralising about transmission routes.
